title: VRAM Detection Fix
headline: This release fixes GPU VRAM reporting so the Dashboard and PC DNA show your real memory, not a 4 GB cap.
changes: Fixed: GPU VRAM now shows the correct amount for modern GPUs (e.g. RX 7800 XT shows 16 GB instead of 4 GB).
Fixed: The root cause was WMI's AdapterRAM field — a 32-bit value that caps at ~4 GB. SwitchControl now uses a ground-truth lookup table for 50+ known cards.
Fixed: Stale disk cache with wrong VRAM values is also corrected on app startup.
Improved: Covers AMD RX 5000-9000, NVIDIA RTX 20-50, GTX 10/16, and Intel Arc series.
